offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures paints, coatings and specialty materials. Sells them to industrial, automotive, aerospace, marine, packaging and construction customers, and to consumers and contractors through paint stores. Produces in its own plants worldwide.

primary_products.value: architectural paints and stains; protective and marine coatings; industrial coatings; automotive refinish coatings; aerospace coatings and sealants; packaging coatings

primary_services.value: color matching and tinting; technical and application support; coatings equipment and process services

customer_segment.value: B2B: automakers, aerospace manufacturers, packaging makers, industrial manufacturers, body shops, painting contractors, infrastructure owners; B2C: home owners and DIY painters buying architectural paint

end_markets.value: construction and home improvement; automotive; aerospace; industrial manufacturing; packaging; marine and infrastructure

revenue_model.value: product sales: paints, coatings, sealants and specialty materials sold by volume; service fees: technical support and application services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes coatings from purchased resins, pigments and solvents, sold to industrial and automotive manufacturers and distributors; brand owner: owns architectural paint brands sold to contractors and consumers; retailer: operates company-owned paint stores selling to professional painters

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific, with operations in over 70 countries

specialization.value: related lines: coatings for industrial, protective, marine, automotive refinish, aerospace, packaging and architectural uses

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: industrial, automotive OEM and aerospace customers; own locations: company-owned paint stores for contractors; third-party retail: home improvement retailers selling architectural paints; distributors / dealers: independent paint and refinish distributors
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; third-party retail; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: chemical and VOC emission rules, product safety and workplace rules from EPA, OSHA and REACH

notes: PPG sold its US and Canada architectural coatings business in 2024, so the architectural line is now mainly outside those two countries. Retail paint store details are approximate.
